pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories.rs:222 The dev-memory packer now correctly skips an item that does not fit instead of stopping (the earlier verdict's defect is fixed), but each skipped item vanishes from the rendered block with no notice of kind, count or cause, so the agent cannot tell that stored constraints or decisions were left out.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories.rs:222 Skip-not-stop is right, but the dropped item leaves no in-band notice. The SQL LIMIT in get_for_injection is a second silent cut.
src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories.rs:249 Packing is now whole-item and skip-don't-stop, but the result never says what it considered and did not show ('the result says what it did not show').
src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev_memories.rs:183 One pure decay score reuses memory_recall's half-life table, so the dev store and persona store age the same kind of item at the same rate.

src-tauri/db/src/repos/twin.rs:621 Approval flips a status on the pending row, and the row stays as the live approved memory read by input.rs:211. Approval now also writes twin_distilled_facts, but readers still pull 'approved' rows from the pending table.
src-tauri/db/src/repos/twin.rs:609 Twin memories distilled from communications go through a human review door before consolidation into facts.
